=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:913 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_placeholder_target_is_local` runs `_DIRECTORY_CHANGE_RE.search(command)` on the raw command only, so a quoted or escaped `cd` (`'cd'`, `"cd"`, `\cd`, `c''d`) is missed. The twin copy in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/ has the same defect.
  WHY: Bash runs `gh` in another checkout, whose remotes may name a different repository, while the guard resolves the placeholder from its own cwd. The write is classified routine and allowed with no prompt.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:373-379,1642-1646 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_may_invoke_gh_api` has no pattern for an expanding command word before `api` (`G=gh; $G api ...`, `` `printf gh` api ``). `evaluate` returns `(None, "")` before `has_hidden_gh_api` runs.
  WHY: The guard abstains and forces no prompt, so a destructive write can run unprompted in auto-run modes. Severity: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite cited line 147 and confidence 4; the others rated confidence 5.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:501 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `shell_segments` replaces backslash-newline with a space (`command.replace("\\\n", " ")`). The early filter joins it with nothing, so a mid-word continuation (`gh a\<newline>pi`) passes the filter but tokenizes as `gh a pi` and no invocation is parsed.
  WHY: Bash removes the continuation and runs `gh api`, but the guard makes no decision. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated this BLOCKER (merged with the `$G api` issue), the others MAJOR.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:1428-1432 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_indirect_gh_command_word_is_never_allowed` asserts only `!= DECISION_ALLOW`, which also passes when the guard returns None.
  WHY: The test hides the abstention and should assert `DECISION_ASK`.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:58,107-108 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The non-raw module docstring contains the invalid escape `\<` at line 58, which gives a SyntaxWarning on Python 3.12+. Lines 107-108 still say the only subprocess is `git config --get remote.origin.url`, though `placeholder_repo_slug` also runs `git config --get-regexp`.
  WHY: A warning goes to stderr on every hook run, and the documented subprocess contract is stale.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:_session_redirects_gh | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: No qualifying defect. The `GH_REPO`, `GH_HOST` and `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` reads are bounded and fail closed.
  WHY: Recorded for completeness only; no action needed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: The guard resolves remotes from its own cwd while Bash runs `gh` in another checkout, so a cross-repository placeholder write is allowed with no prompt.

  PROBLEM: There is no pattern for an expanding command word before `api`, so `evaluate` returns `(None, "")` and the `$G api` branch of `has_hidden_gh_api` is unreachable.
  WHY: The guard abstains on a destructive write. `test_indirect_gh_command_word_is_never_allowed` passes on None, and the changelog and docstring wrongly claim this form prompts.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:501 (`shell_segments`; also `_may_invoke_gh_api` at 368 and 379) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The early filter joins backslash-newline with nothing, but `shell_segments` replaces it with a space, so `gh a\<newline>pi` is not parsed.
  WHY: Bash runs `gh api` and the guard returns nothing. The new test covers only `gh \<newline>api`.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:58,108 (module docstring) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Line 58 has the invalid escape `\<`, which gives a SyntaxWarning on Python 3.12+. Line 108 is stale about the subprocess `git config --get-regexp`.
  WHY: The warning goes to stderr on every run, and the documented subprocess contract is out of date.
